select rtp.SEQNO seqno, rtp.ORG_CODE orgCode, rtp.REPORT_CODE reportCode, rtp.TYPE_DETAIL typeDetail, rtp.SUBMIT_TIMETYPE submitTimetype, rtp.SUBMIT_REQUIRE3 submitRequire3, rtp.SUBMIT_REQUIRE2 submitRequire2, rtp.SUBMIT_REQUIRE submitRequire, rtp.SUBMIT_POINT_BOND submitPointBond, rtp.SUBMIT_POINT_BANK submitPointBank, rtp.UPDATE_SUBMIT_POINT updateSubmitPoint, rtp.DELETE_SUBMING_POINT deleteSubmingPoint, rtp.STATUS status, rtp.WORKFLOW_ID workflowId, rtp.UPDATE_USER updateUser, rtp.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, rtp.CREATE_USER createUser, rtp.CREATE_TIME createTime from CHB_REG_TIME_POINTS rtp where rtp.STATUS = 'E' and rtp.REPORT_CODE = #{reportCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and rtp.TYPE_DETAIL #{typeDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select deadline1.* from(select rownum num, deadline.* from( SELECT A.BUSI_DATE busiDate, A.MARKET_CODE marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday, A.STATUS status, A.DEPT_CODE deptCode FROM CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY A
A.BUSI_DATE < to_date(#{holidayDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
A.BUSI_DATE > to_date(#{holidayDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.STATUS = 'E' AND A.IS_HOLIDAY = '1'
order by A.BUSI_DATE desc
order by A.BUSI_DATE asc
)deadline )deadline1 where deadline1.num = #{days,jdbcType=INTEGER}

select deadline1.* from(select rownum num,deadline.* from( SELECT A.BUSI_DATE busiDate, A.MARKET_CODE marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday, A.STATUS status, A.DEPT_CODE deptCode FROM CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY A
A.BUSI_DATE <= to_date(#{holidayDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
A.BUSI_DATE >= to_date(#{holidayDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.STATUS = 'E' AND A.IS_HOLIDAY = '1'
order by A.BUSI_DATE desc
order by A.BUSI_DATE asc
)deadline )deadline1 where deadline1.num = 1

select BUSI_DATE busiDate, MARKET_CODE marketCode, IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday, WORKFLOW_ID workflowId, STATUS status from CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY where BUSI_DATE = #{busiDate,jdbcType=DATE} and MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
